Class Hand

java.lang.Object
org.engine.card.Hand
public final class Hand extends Object
Represents a player's hand of cards. Cards are unordered and unique.

  • Constructor Details

    • Hand

      public Hand(Collection<Card> cards)
      Creates a hand containing the given cards. Duplicate cards are silently deduplicated; the collection is copied and not held by reference.
      Parameters:
      cards - the cards for this hand
